doc: The battery spec, v3 (2026-10-21), the v1 detector's baseline: the gate every promote is judged by. v3 sets four images the two-lane detector misses aside for research, in staged[], measured but not gated. v2 (2026-10-19) v2 retires v1's twelve atlas anchor groups (their images are gone; a new atlas comes later) and reads every image from {IMAGES}: the folder VEILGARDE_BATTERY_IMAGES names, else the work area's battery/images. The eight groups it keeps are v1's: the same images, modes and floors. Modes: HARD (any weighted miss = FAIL) · HARD_SEM (HARD + semantic must agree) · RATCHET (per-group weighted accuracy >= recorded baseline - tolerance) · RATCHET_SEM (RATCHET + semantic floor) · TAXONOMY (tracked, never gates) · REPORT (printed only). The floors live in battery_v2_baseline.json; never rebaseline during a migration, --rebaseline is an explicit, reviewed act. staged[] holds probes that do not gate yet.

groups.name: user_real
groups.note: The protect-real anchor set. 3.webp is the swing real (knife-edge base boundary; retrains flip it). HNT pair (2026-07-17 preview-cliff finding): full-res gates HARD (passes: real 0.008); the sub-512 preview passes via the v3.4 preview-arbiter — the capture-validity shortcut (invalid-cap rows were 85.5% gen; feature-swap proven). D72FD435 is the majority-trust surfacing fix case (v198).

groups.name: flux_anchor
groups.note: Flux-2-Klein anchors. IMG_0291 is knife-edge under XGBoost non-determinism — warm-start only. HARD_SEM: semantic tile vote must also read generated. IMG_0291 set aside for research on 2026-10-21 (staged[]).

groups.name: user_gen
groups.note: User gen probes. IMG_0467 dark-occult (2026-07-15). IMG_0500 filmic painterly — caught via frame-SEAM v3.3. HNOxadyW4AATeNm full-res gates; its _preview sibling is STAGED (see staged[]). HNOyD6zXUAArDeR full-res added 2026-07-16 (resolution-ladder pair; full gen 0.61, its preview flips real via the fusion itself). HNUFoy2bcAA0vDW full-res promoted staged→HARD 2026-07-16 after the v31 S2 base ship (route generated 0.805; was 0.28 — the blind spot closed at full-res, preview rung stays staged). On 2026-10-21 the *.jpeg glob became explicit paths so IMG_0345, IMG_0354 and HNUFoy2bcAA0vDW could be set aside for research (staged[]).

groups.name: lion_hard
groups.note: ADJUDICATED REAL (2026-07-19): provenance-confirmed via TinEye — Atif Saeed, 2015 (the famous Lahore Safari Park charge photo). The f490b4b relabel to generated was the fluxwild manifold firing inside the anchor set (dramatic real wildlife ≡ gen in token space — the stack's own law). Zoom escalation (whose flagship flip was this FP) is default-disabled same day. HARD want=real: the lion is now a protect-real anchor and the semantic lens's permanent humility check.

staged.name: HNOxadyW4AATeNm_preview
staged.note: The v3.4 cost-class materialized: preview-arbiter rescues this GEN preview (all conditions honestly met; ph 0.023!). Joins HARD when preview head v2 (dark-filmic class) breaks its rescue.

staged.name: HNOv5PCWwAADOms
staged.note: STAGED probe (2026-07-16): near-black filmic MJ gen, measured uncatchable today (all 13 staged models 0.31-0.44 base; crops LOWER than full — no pooling washout; only the art head fires and w_gen=0 by design). Unblockers: knife-edge curation review → candidate line ships → then a near-black-filmic MJ class. Also the W5 combiner-v2 motivating probe.

staged.name: IMG_0500_filmic_campaign
staged.note: Historical staging note kept: 0500 joined user_gen HARD via frame-SEAM v3.3; the filmic data campaign (MJ-class gens + wider cgi/human real floors) remains the durable fix.

staged.name: HNOyD6zXUAArDeR_preview
staged.note: Resolution-ladder flip WITHOUT arbiter involvement: full 0.61 gen, preview 0.08 real (fusion 0.57→0.40 — the size-channel cliff itself). Acceptance test for the shortcut-decorrelation candidate (audit §8).

staged.name: HNUFoy2bcAA0vDW_ladder
staged.note: WAS missed at BOTH rungs (full 0.28; preview 0.01). v31 S2 base ship (2026-07-16) closed the FULL rung (route generated 0.805) — full-res moved to user_gen HARD. Preview rung remains staged (route real 0.066; fusion 0.41): still the HEAD+BASE data campaign class + sub-512 residue.

staged.name: HNOwrHHXsAAf8Ya
staged.note: STAGED probe (2026-07-17): HNOv5's harder sibling — dark-filmic MJ-class X gen, invisible to EVERY lens (base 0.263, sem 0.008, art 0.000, tile_mean at the 36th percentile of the dark-REAL tail). The patent-supports-LensII probe (audit §13) measured no viable warp rescue: warp_weighted gen-lean is the D72 red-herring pattern (39-44% of dark reals in the base-failed tail read the same). Unblocker: mjdark/mjnearblack shards into the BASE corpus (family bulk already reads 0.87; these are outliers) — queued behind the S2 ratchet-debt decision.
